record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare BANEFUL_BUNKER: Toxapex (2 stars) and Mareanie (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (both maxPP 100, range 1). Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs no target (cast from the moving state with target null once pp >= maxPP and canCast). For 2000 ms the caster gains protect (unless it is already protected or enraged), and a retaliation effect is attached to it: whenever an attacker whose attack was just processed stands at Chebyshev distance exactly 1 from the caster, that attacker takes SPECIAL damage (requested 10 at 1 star, 20 at 2 stars; 30 at 3 stars, 50 at 4 stars or as the ?? fallback) and gets one poison stack of 3000 ms with the caster as origin. At the moment of the cast every enemy in the 8 adjacent cells is forced to retarget the caster (taunt). The retaliation effect is added even when protect was not applied, and lasts 2000 ms regardless.

targeting.who: self (protect, retaliation effect); the taunt hits every enemy-team entity in the 8 cells around the caster; retaliation hits each adjacent attacker individually
targeting.note: Taunt: Board.getAdjacentCells (row-major, centre excluded) and cell.value.team !== caster team; setTarget(caster) with no range, status or targettability check. Retaliation: evaluated in the ATTACKER's onAttack (called after every attack, successful or not, including attacks the protect turned into zero damage), using the positions at that moment; attackers at distance 2 or more (ranged) trigger nothing. Only basic attacks reach this path (onAttack); ability damage does not call OnAttackReceivedEffect in the code read.

geometry.shape: taunt on the 8 surrounding cells at cast time; retaliation condition is Chebyshev distance 1 (the same 8 cells) at each received attack

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: applied only if the caster is not already protected and not enraged (protect cannot be stacked or refreshed); ends when protectCooldown - dt <= 0. While protected: basic attacks on it do 0 damage and count as unsuccessful, ability damage through handleSpecialDamage/handleDamage returns takenDamage 0, and it receives no healing.

effects.target: each adjacent attacker, per attack received while the effect lasts
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] ?? 50 using the bunker's stars when the retaliation runs. handleSpecialDamage with the bunker as attacker: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE, x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT; the crit argument is the literal false, so no crit multiplier applies even if the cast crit.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef of the attacker), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the attacker's shield absorb first; takenDamage (not stored by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage, 0 if the attacker is protected / skydiving / magicBounce. One retaliation per received attack (per attack, not per hit-point); several overlapping effects from repeated casts would each retaliate.

effects.target: every enemy in the 8 adjacent cells at cast time
effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: immediate, once; the enemy's target is reassigned without checks for range, status or immunities; it may retarget later through normal targeting.

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: a new OnAttackReceivedEffect is added to the caster's effectsSet at cast and removed by a DelayedCommand pushed on the caster's commands (advanced by the caster's state update; it runs once its delay has dropped below 0), so the effect lasts about 2000 ms of simulation time. It is added whether or not protect was applied.

declaredRaw.label: requested duration and stacks per retaliation

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: a triggerPoison call does nothing if the attacker has IMMUNITY_POISON or runeProtect. Otherwise poisonOrigin = the bunker, stacks + 1 up to 3 (4 if the bunker has VENOMOUS, 5 TOXIC), duration passes through the attacker's reductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then -10% per Odd Keystone) and replaces the timer only if longer; GUTS (+5 attack once) and TOXIC_BOOST (+10 once) react; a Pecha Berry holder eats the berry. While poisoned the attacker takes TRUE damage of 5% max HP per stack per tick (reduced by rain, Assault Vest, TOXIC_BOOST, water effects).

starBehavior.note: Only the retaliation damage depends on stars (index stars-1 of the caster at retaliation time). Protect duration, effect duration, poison and taunt are star-independent. 30 (3 stars) and 50 (4 stars / fallback) are not reachable by the listed units at their bare factory stars.

record.positionalConditions: Taunt reaches only the 8 surrounding cells at cast time. Retaliation requires Chebyshev distance exactly 1 between the caster and the attacker at the moment of each attack; the caster can move during the 2000 ms.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and adds its own effect object removed after 2000 ms by a DelayedCommand (advanced by the caster's state update). A recast while protect is still running does not re-apply or extend protect, but adds a second retaliation effect, so overlapping effects each fire.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: protect 2000 ms; retaliation damage 10 (Mareanie, 1 star) / 20 (Toxapex, 2 stars); poison 1 stack, 3000 ms. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional DOUBLE_DAMAGE / steam, no crit (literal false), then SPE_DEF division, round up and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is not used by the strategy. Applied protect only if not already protected/enraged. Applied poison duration after the attacker's reductions, stack capped, blocked by immunity/rune protect.
